Top DO overlap: Number of candidate DO-laws (deployment/positive laws) shared between the two runs' independently selected top-12 DO lists, out of 12. A law counts as shared only if its normalized key (META_ACTION + META_CONCEPT + Action_Operator + Target_Block + Target_Slot + Field_Policy) matches exactly in both lists; score values and rank order are not part of the key.
Number of candidate AVOID-laws (recall-risk/negative laws) shared between the two runs' independently selected top-12 AVOID lists, out of 12, using the same strict normalized key as above.
Sum of the DO overlap count and the AVOID overlap count, out of 24 (12 DO + 12 AVOID). Combines both law families into a single agreement measure across the two runs.

Number of laws with an identical strict normalized key present in BOTH runs' FULL candidate law sets (before the top-12 DO / top-12 AVOID selection cap is applied), out of the size of the smaller of the two candidate sets.

Overlap coefficient (Szymkiewicz-Simpson) = Shared / min(|candidate set A|, |candidate set B|), computed on the full (uncapped) candidate law sets. Measures how much of the smaller run's candidate laws are also found in the other run's candidate laws, without truncating either list to the top 12.

Run1=29, Run2=30, Run3=32, Pooled=37 total candidate laws (all types combined: CONDITIONAL, RECALL_PROTECTIVE, AVOID, NOISE_REDUCTION), before the top-12 DO / top-12 AVOID selection cap and before final refinement. Source: public_release/revision_reruns/rule_extraction_sensitivity/candidate_rules_pre_refinement/ and refined_rulebooks/refined_rulebook_manifest.csv (candidate_laws column).

Run1/Run2/Run3 vs Pooled all show Overlap coefficient = 1.000 because the pooled candidate set was extracted from the union of all three runs' logs (33 logs total), so every candidate law found in any individual run is, by construction, also present in the pooled set. The more informative reproducibility comparisons are Run1 vs Run2, Run1 vs Run3, and Run2 vs Run3.
